pages.title: Banking Soul Fire
pages.text: Right-click the pedestal with soul sand to bank fuel, up to 3 at a time. Light it with flint and steel once it holds at least one.

While lit, right-click an item into the pedestal to convert it into mana. The amount generated depends on the item's rarity - common items yield little, rare and epic items yield much more. Every so often the pedestal burns through one banked soul sand; banking all three lets it run three times as long between refills.
A lit pedestal periodically rescans nearby chunks for Lens Pedestals and sends the full mana output to every one it finds linked - multiple linked pedestals is an intentional multiplier, not a split.
